notes: LANDED kb/Work PB1123 (INSPECT arm) and PB5184 (the function operands). InspectEmitter.IdentifyOperands freezes identifier-1, every counter and every operand (subscripts, reference-modification start/length, Tier-B window offsets) into locals in source order before anything is read or stored, through the one PlaceIdentification.Freeze helper; YE(J) TALLYING J addresses the YE(1) it identified. A function-identifier operand has no address to freeze, so EmitBody's Once evaluates each one, in any phrase (TALLYING, REPLACING, CONVERTING), into a local in source order before the first counter is stored: TALLYING I ... REPLACING ALL FUNCTION UPPER-CASE (LIT (I)) BY "Z" reads LIT (1) (pb5184_replacing_function_once). The UNSTRING/INVOKE/ODO-refmod arms of PB1123 are not this row.
